cart.title: Cart

checkout.title: Review and submit request
checkout.intro: Your request is reviewed before it becomes a sales order. You'll be notified at each step.
checkout.introRetail: Pay online and your order is confirmed straight away.
checkout.notesPlaceholder: Delivery window, contact at the gate…

checkout.offlineNote: You're offline. The request is saved on this device and sent when you reconnect. It isn't submitted until then.
checkout.indicative: Prices are indicative. The ERP confirms the final price when the order is created.

done.submittedText: It's waiting for review. We'll notify you when it becomes a sales order.
done.convertedText: Request {request} was approved automatically and is now a sales order.
done.draftText: It's sent automatically when you're back online. It isn't submitted until then.

assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.disclaimer: Mock responses. Future version will use permission-checked business functions via the backend.

offline.banner: You are offline. Catalog and recent data are served from cache; new orders are saved as Pending Sync.

access.title: Module access
access.subtitle: Choose which modules each role can use. Menus and pages follow these settings as soon as you save.
access.serverNote: When the backend is connected it enforces the same rules on every request, so hiding a menu is never the only protection.
access.lockedHint: Dashboard and notifications are always on. Administrators always keep Users, Module access and Settings, so nobody gets locked out.
access.deniedTitle: You don't have access to this page

customerDash.noOrdersHint: Browse the catalogue to place your first order.

sites.title: Sites

workflow.intro: Rules for sales requests. Administrators and supervisors can change them.

credit.title: Credit limit
credit.text: What happens when a request takes a business customer over their credit limit, or the account is on hold.
credit.blockText: It can't be submitted until the balance is paid.
credit.warnText: It's submitted and flagged; a reviewer can approve it with an override.
credit.none: No exceptions. Every customer follows the rule above.

auto.title: Auto-approval
auto.text: Requests within credit and up to this total become sales orders without review.

b2c.title: Retail customers
b2c.text: Create the sales order as soon as an online payment succeeds.

hold.title: Stock hold
hold.text: Hold stock for a submitted request while it's reviewed. 0 turns this off.

expiry.title: Request expiry
expiry.text: Requests not converted within this many days expire. 0 means never.

supplierCatalog.title: My products
supplierCatalog.intro: Products you supply to us, with our stock at {site}. Offer stock for pickup and we'll turn it into a purchase order.
supplierCatalog.dialogText: We review your offer and create a purchase order.
supplierCatalog.empty: No products are linked to your supplier account yet.

purchaseRequests.title: Purchase requests
purchaseRequests.introSupplier: Your pickup requests and their status.
purchaseRequests.introBuyer: Pickup offers from suppliers and internal purchase requests at this site.
purchaseRequests.emptyHint: Pickup offers and internal requests appear here.
purchaseRequests.convertText: The order is created in {erp} and sent to {supplier}.
purchaseRequests.noLow: Nothing from this supplier is low on stock at {site}.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase orders
purchaseOrders.introSupplier: Orders from us. Acknowledge them, confirm pickup and mark them dispatched.
purchaseOrders.introBuyer: Purchase orders and goods receipts at this site.
purchaseOrders.emptyHint: Purchase orders appear here when a purchase request is converted.
purchaseOrders.pickupText: Tell us when and how the goods leave.
purchaseOrders.receiveText: Enter the quantities that arrived. Anything not received stays open.
purchaseOrders.cancelText: The supplier is notified with your reason.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.intro: Stock at {site}: what is on hand, reserved, free to promise and on the way.
inventory.search: Search by product, SKU or brand
inventory.legend: Allocated: on sales orders not yet shipped. Held: kept for submitted requests while stock hold is on. Available = on hand − allocated − held. Consignment stock belongs to customer agreements and is not included.

transfers.title: Stock transfers
transfers.intro: Stock moving into and out of {site}.
transfers.newIntro: Ask another site to send stock. A supervisor approves it, the source site ships it and this site receives it.
transfers.overWarning: Some quantities are more than {site} has free today. You can still ask; the transfer can only ship when the stock is there.
transfers.receiveText: Enter what arrived. Anything short is recorded on the transfer for investigation.

hint.pending: Waiting for a supervisor to approve.
hint.transferred: Received at {to}. Check it and complete the transfer.

consignment.title: Consignment stock
consignment.introCustomer: Stock we keep for you at our warehouse. Call off what you need and we deliver it.
consignment.emptyCustomer: Ask your sales representative about holding stock for you at our warehouse.
consignment.callOffIntro: Enter the quantities you need and send a call-off. It becomes a sales request like any other order.
consignment.staffIntro: Call-offs from this customer appear as sales requests. Top up when stock falls below the agreed minimum.
consignment.callOffText: This creates a sales request against your consignment stock.
consignment.topUpText: Move free stock at {site} into location {location}.

account.title: Account & finance
account.intro: Balances come from the {erp} receivables ledger.
account.statementInfo: {erp} generates the statement of account as a PDF.
account.bankHint: After paying by transfer or cheque, use “I've paid” so we can match your payment quickly.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.intro: Tax invoices from {erp}. Pay online or tell us about a transfer.

quotes.declineText: Tell us why, so we can do better next time.

deliveries.failText: The customer is told and the delivery can be rescheduled.
